briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate Pumitamig Versus Durvalumab Following Concurrent Chemoradiation Therapy in Participants With Unresectable Stage III Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) (ROSETTA Lung-201)

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have an active autoimmune disease.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have significant cardiovascular impairment such as uncontrolled hypertension (despite optimal medical treatment), congestive heart failure, active coronary disease (within 6 months prior to randomization), ventricular arrhythmias, major thrombotic or embolic events or major hemorrhagic events within 6 months prior to randomization, or significant risk of pulmonary hemorrhage.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex cardiovascular exclusions with multiple clauses are not captured by single typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have advanced/clinically significant lung disease (within 6 months prior to randomization) or history of interstitial lung disease (ILD) or pneumonitis requiring treatment with systemic steroids (≥ Grade 2), or current or suspected ILD or pneumonitis.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pulmonary disease and ILD history with steroid grading are complex clinical judgments.
